messages.content: Compare students with and without part-time jobs based on their average final exam score.

The average final exam score for students with part-time jobs is 81.29, while the average final exam score for students without part-time jobs is 84.58. This suggests that students without part-time jobs tend to perform slightly better on their final exams, with an average score about 3.29 points higher than those with part-time jobs.
messages.sql: SELECT AVG(final_exam_score) AS average_final_exam_score FROM student_performance_dataset WHERE part_time_job = 'No'
